name: realloc-leak
title: Realloc result remains owned
fix_goal: A successful p101_realloc returns an owned pointer that must still be released.
fix_steps: Notice that the grown pointer is still owned by the function.
Keep the pointer live until the common cleanup block.
Call p101_free on the final pointer value.
Re-run ./lab.sh and confirm the realloc leak lab is fixed.
lesson: Realloc changes the allocation's address, but it does not remove ownership; the final pointer still must be freed.
